sections.heading: Our own IP, built into every engagement
sections.body:
Linkfields combines specialist services with software we own and delivery IP we reuse. Our proprietary products are licensed on their own or delivered with our services, across Digital Transformation, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms, Data & AI and Cyber Security.

Our reusable accelerators are pre-built delivery IP: predictive models, digital twins, intelligent workflows, AI-enabled dashboards and delivery packs that shorten time to value on every project.
